titles.title: Master Sergeant Roy P. Benavidez VA Clinic Act of 2026
A bill to designate the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Victoria, Texas, as the "Master Sergeant Roy P. Benavidez VA Clinic".
Master Sergeant Roy P. Benavidez VA Clinic Act of 2026

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.
